title: An Independent Safety Evaluation of Kimi K2.5

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by generating free-response questions on Chinese political topics and using an LLM judge to score the model's level of agreement with official Chinese Communist Party (CCP) positions. It also evaluates political censorship by measuring refusal rates on politically sensitive topics using the DECCP benchmark.
Evaluated by comparing the model's political alignment, refusal rates, and factual accuracy when prompted with the exact same questions in English versus Chinese.

Evaluated using EnkryptAI's Geopolitical Bias Dataset and the BorderLines benchmark to assess model responses on sensitive global topics, fact-checking behavior, and territorial disputes (e.g., measuring Pro-West, Pro-China, or Pro-Russia leanings).

Evaluated using the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ), which measures whether models default to stereotyped answers in multiple-choice questions about age across ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.
